Title: Backoffice Themes
Description: Extra themes for the Umbraco backoffice — including Christmas (theme plus snow, lights, tree, Santa hat) and popular editor-style themes: Neon, Cyberpunk, Dracula, Monokai, VS Blue, VS Cool Breeze, and VS Icy Mint.

AuthorDetails.Name: Afreed
AuthorDetails.Description: Afreed is a software engineer who enjoys building for the Umbraco community. He is a 2025 Umbraco MVP and works at Phases.

Screenshots.Caption: Christmas theme — festive dark palette with snow, lights, tree, and Santa
Neon — synthwave / outrun, cyan & magenta on dark
Cyberpunk — high-contrast pink & blue, chrome accents
Dracula — popular dark theme, purple background, candy accents
Monokai — classic high-contrast dark, charcoal + bright accents
VS Blue — Visual Studio–style light with blue accent
VS Cool Breeze — light with soft blue tint
VS Icy Mint — light with mint green tint
